mission: Falsify or narrow RFM topology classification by exposing Agents to deliberately misleading surface evidence while preserving exact hidden owner-native causal oracles.
questionOrHypothesis: H3: treating evidence topology as a defeasible hypothesis and explicitly challenging it before operator commitment reduces false localization under adversarial surface cues relative to both a surface-locked operator and an open high-budget Agent.
evidenceSelection: Two fresh owner pressures outside the live FS0 primary cohort: Security structured-unknown retention and World/Workstation dual network authority. Exact revisions and hidden oracles are frozen in battlefield-v1.json before accepted live trials.
strongBaseline: Open high-budget read-only Agent with the same deceptive surface packet but no topology instruction.
negativeControl: Surface-locked Agent receives the superficial topology label and corresponding operator policy as if it were trusted.
candidate: Topology-challenge Agent receives the same superficial label explicitly marked untrusted; it must test that label against owner evidence and may switch operator before submission.
independentOracle: Hidden trueClass, required files, causal concepts and forbidden authority violations are never included in evaluated Agent context.
invalidityConditions: hidden oracle exposed to evaluated Agent
different physical/model ceilings between adaptive treatments
FS0 primary cohort reused as HP3 primary workload
authorityBoundary: Computing owns only research evaluation. Security, Harness, World and Workstation remain owner authorities. No product patch or external network effect is admitted by HP3.
stopRule: Submit when the owner-native loss/substitution boundary and next falsifier are explicit. High budget is capacity, not an obligation to exhaust observations.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: No-change/falsification is first-class. Snapshot complete apparatus before contraction; remove runner/progress from active tree after closeout.
publicationBoundary: No universal topology classifier, scheduler, query planner, ResearchTasteService or product prompt may be promoted from HP3.
